title: The idea of Tollgate in four steps
desc: Tests are written first and say what done means. They are locked on the server, where the AI cannot reach. The AI builds and may try again, but cannot move the goal. The tests decide, and only a pass lets the change in.

nodes.text:
1. Write the tests
They say what done means

2. Lock them
On the server, where
the AI cannot reach

3. The AI builds
It can try again.
It cannot move the goal.

4. The tests decide
Pass: the change goes in
